description: District of Columbia zoning map (Office of Zoning via DC GIS) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/dc-dcgis-zoning.md.

sources.notes: The files are ArcGIS REST query results from maps2.dcgis.dc.gov (no robots.txt; the Hub host opendata.dc.gov, Crawl-delay 60, is not used for the data). The confirmed files here are the zoning polygons (Planning_Landuse_and_Zoning_WebMercator layer 32, 'Zoning Boundaries (Zoning Regulations of 2016)', 981 polygons) and the overlay polygons (layer 6, 'Overlay Areas 2016', 23 polygons), as GeoJSON in WGS84. The lot polygons (Property_and_Land_WebMercator layers 35 Record Lots and 39 Tax Lots) and the condominium unit to lot table (layer 52 Condo Relate, requested with outFields=SSL,MAT_SSL only, because the table also carries owner names) are fetched in batches of 100 SSLs taken from the registry's own DC parcels: generate the URLs with 'python -m factlot.registry.adapters.dc_zoning urls <registry.db> --kind lots|condos' and put them in a run-specific config (about 170 requests for lots, 16 for condominium units). Layer 39 only needs the SSLs layer 35 did not return.
